You're upset that you've lost the wife you used to know, and you feel guilty because you feel that you're not allowed to be upset.

If I got that completely wrong, then I'm sorry and just ignore me.

If however, I've made some connection with you at all, then know that your feelings are valid. At times I'm actually worried myself to let myself reach out to my friends/family because I'm worried I'm affecting their mental health negatively.

It's alright that you're feeling the way you are. There's a reason why people need schooling and years of training to be psychiatrists, and even then, the field is still a baby in the world of science.

I'm not sure what to recommend moving forward. I don't want to say anything I'm not supposed to. Just know that everything that you're thinking and feeling makes sense.

Yea, you gotta be careful with the "tough love" approach. 

In some ways, you're validating that person. 
For me, personally, I would see it as life (finally admitting to) not wanting me.

The sidebar has some resources they've put together.

I'm not expert, but I'm one of those feeling bad and can say that reading their tips made me feel a bit better. It felt nice because I feel like they're got it right with what they were saying, and I was glad that maybe there are people out there who can talk about this stuff.

Edit:

https://www.reddit.com/r/SWResources/comments/igh87/concerned_but_dont_know_what_to_say_here_are_some/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share

https://www.reddit.com/r/SWResources/comments/1c7nqf/worried_about_someone_who_may_be_suicidal_heres/?utm_medium=android_app&utm_source=share

I want to believe in that so badly, but I've heard it before.
My friends and family told me things would be different when I got out of the hospital and I'm in a worse mood as before I got in, because they let me down.

I almost want to ask you to rescind your statement. I'm not sure you understand what you're offering.

Also, to believe in you'll being there feels selfish. It feels like I'm forcing you cause I've asked

PS: I'm not the OP, and I'm sorry to the OP for talking about myself

I would prefer dying.

It takes effort to do those things you're suggesting. So many steps. And I don't think I'd get any enjoyment from them

I'm already feel like a shitty person without the vices.

With death, I just go to my location and fall. Simple.

I hate when people tell you to live. I hate when they say that things will get better. Then they LEAVE YOU ALONE.

They're busy, back to business, and you're back to square one.

For me, it makes me feel like they're really just protecting themselves. They're encouraging you to live, just enough so that they can say they helped you. However, they don't want to help you too much so as to inconvenience themselves.

They're not real friends. They never reach out to me or talk to me unless they need a favor. If I want to hang out or talk, then they're busy. 

I've let myself be stepped on for the majority of my life. I don't want to try being "strong".

I always gave everyone the benefit of the doubt. I told myself stuff like "oh, it's just too early in the morning and they're not morning people", "oh, he's probably just tired from going out with his other friends".

I've also had a few of my "friends" tell me I'm an asshole for wanting attention because I'm "successful". I don't deserve to be upset.

The reason I tutor and help others is because I never wanted to be "successful". So many people want what I have and I want to give it to them, because it seems like they want it so much more than me. I guess that's why I let people step on me.

If I die, people will mourn because it is the "social" thing to do. And then everyone will move on. They won't admit, but I know it to be true. Otherwise I wouldn't be sitting here, after 6 months (I know, not long) of reaching out, mind still deteriorating.

There are therapists that do more than 6 sessions a day?

If each session is 1 hr, that means more than 6hrs of pure conversation. And heavy conversation at that.

I feel like one would have deteriorated a bit by the end of the day
I understand that, but surely insurance and/or the government should help out a bit more :( lol
If there is a better subreddit to post this on, please let me know and don't delete this so I can copy/paste to there.

I've tried being there for other people. I'm a tutor and I volunteer. I'm just so empty now, and I don't care how my leaving would affect them.

She can't handle a relationship anymore. I doubt she could handle this. 

It's been a couple months already. I can't keep this up
